visual.name: plumeBeeswarm
visual.description: Beeswarm chart with the Plume Studio look: every item as a dot placed along a value axis without overlap, one band per group, colors by legend, sizes by a measure; median and mean; jitter and strip layouts; premium features: play axis where dots glide from one year to the next, quartiles, box plot, violin and raincloud, sieve layout, per-item comparison with a reference, in-visual search, small multiples and embedded images. Up to 100,000 dots on a canvas.
